title: Kinetic Vietnamese Cabbage Banh Cuon
description: A light, bitter, energizing Vietnamese roll featuring hispi sweetheart cabbage and confit tomato, steamed to perfection.

ingredients.name: fresh tomatoes
ingredients.notes: cut into small cubes for confit

instructions: Combine the shredded cabbage, minced garlic, grated ginger, and sea salt in a bowl and let it sit for 5 minutes to soften.
In a separate pan, heat olive oil over medium heat and add the cubed tomatoes, cooking until they turn soft and release juice, then set aside to cool.
Whisk rice flour and water together until smooth, then stir in black pepper and lime juice to make the batter.
Preheat a steamer or pot with a steamer basket over boiling water, ensuring the water does not touch the batter.
Pour a thin layer of batter into a heat‑proof silicone mold or a greased plate, spreading it evenly to form a thin sheet.
Steam the batter sheet for 3 minutes until it sets and becomes translucent.
Remove the sheet from the steamer and spread a thin layer of the cooled confit tomatoes over the surface.
Sprinkle the marinated cabbage mixture evenly across the tomato layer, then fold the sheet into a roll or cut into bite‑sized squares.
Return the rolled or sliced banh cuon to the steamer and steam for an additional 4 minutes to meld flavors.
Serve hot, garnished with sliced scallions and a drizzle of lime juice, feeling the kinetic energy of the dish.
